outcome: Foetal umbilical cord blood Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor (BDNF) levels
cohort: A total of 96 participants were included, comprising 43 women with gestational diabetes mellitus and 53 non-diabetic control women, along with their infants from whom cord blood samples were taken at delivery.
finding: This study found that gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) has no significant effect on foetal umbilical cord blood BDNF levels, although cord blood BDNF values were higher in female infants and in infants of GDM patients using insulin.
cross-section timing: Immediately after the foetal umbilical cord was clamped during delivery
